europe_now.title: French Critical Infrastructure Protection
europe_now.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has ordered a comprehensive plan to safeguard critical national infrastructure against potential hybrid attacks originating from Russia. The measure follows heightened security concerns across European nations regarding covert operations and regional destabilization efforts.

sources.headline: 🔴 Macron orders plan to protect France critical infrastructure against 'Russian hybrid attacks'
Macron orders plan to protect France's critical infrastructure against 'Russian hybrid attacks'

europe_now.title: EU Funding for Ukrainian Drones
europe_now.summary: The European Union has committed €3.3 billion to support the acquisition and deployment of Ukrainian drones. However, broader financial requirements and unresolved funding gaps persist as the region prepares for difficult winter conditions.

sources.headline: EU commits €3.3bn to Ukrainian drones as funding gap remains unresolved ahead of ‘tough winter’

top_stories.title: French Public Spending Reductions
top_stories.summary: The French Prime Minister has announced plans to reduce public spending significantly to address the national fiscal deficit. Officials intend to implement fifty-four billion euros in budget cuts as part of broader fiscal policy changes.

sources.headline: French PM vows to cut public spending by €54 billion to reduce deficit

top_stories.title: Migrant Clearance Operations in Ceuta
top_stories.summary: Spanish law enforcement authorities launched operations to clear hundreds of migrants remaining on beaches in the enclave of Ceuta. The actions led to chaotic scenes as police moved individuals away from the coastal areas.
